scale_design_policy: Al-Dhahabi's vocabulary in al-Kashif differs from Ibn Hajar's 12 maratib in Taqrib. We map explicit verdicts onto a coarse 3-tier scale (2=thiqah_level, 1=saduq_level, 0=weak_and_below) and an optional 5-tier scale (5=superlative/sahabi, 4=thiqah, 3=saduq, 2=mild_weak_or_majhul, 1=severe_weak_or_abandoned). Silent entries (~2,500) and mixed/contested entries are recorded as 'unmapped', never guessed.
